tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Use this when the user wants their own picture, words or logo printed on a T-shirt, hoodie, sweatshirt or tote bag and delivered, as a gift or for themselves. Finds products by free text, category, colour and size. Returns product_id, image_url (a product photo, or null), colours, sizes and print pl

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product: colours with hex codes and product photos (images: url, view, style, alt; empty when none yet; ai_generated marks AI photos), sizes, variant ids, print placements with the print area in mm, placement presets (for example center_chest, left_chest, full_front, full_back),

tools.name: validate_artwork
tools.description: Upload artwork and check that it prints well on one product placement. Send exactly one of: artwork with svg (markup, best for text and logos), base64 (a PNG, JPEG or SVG file up to about 2 MB, no data: prefix) or url (a public HTTPS link to the file); file (a file object from your client); or uploa

tools.name: create_mockup
tools.description: Render a preview PNG of the artwork on the product in the chosen colour and placement. style flat draws the placement; style packshot uses a product photo with the exact print at real size, or gives the flat preview with a note when no photo exists. Returns mockup_url, blank_image_url and image_prom

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Price printed items delivered to one destination. Returns quote_id, the total that the payer pays (products, shipping and VAT where AgentMade collects it), what is not included, the delivery estimate and the expiry. tools.name: purchase
tools.description: Turn a quote into an order. Needs quote_id, the full recipient address (it must match the quoted destination) and rights_attestation=true. contact_email is the payer's own email, never the gift recipient's. Returns order_id and payment.url: the order page where the person pays by card, Apple Pay or

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Current order status (AWAITING_PAYMENT, PAID, SUBMITTED, IN_PRODUCTION, SHIPPED, DELIVERED or an exception state), next_step in plain language, the payment link while unpaid, shipments and a timeline.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Carrier, tracking number and tracking link for each shipment of an order, and the delivery estimate.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order. Unpaid: closes the payment link; nothing is charged. Paid and not yet in production: cancels and refunds in full. In production or shipped: cannot be cancelled; the error gives the reason. A second call on a cancelled order is safe.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "pay" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, validate_artwork · Private data: validate_artwork · Public sink: validate_artwork, purchase.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, validate_artwork · Private data: validate_artwork · Public sink: validate_artwork, purchase

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
